newsitem.title: USA: Commerce Dept's Ehrlich to leave at month-end - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Commerce Dept's Ehrlich to leave at month-end - NYT.

text.p: U.S. Commerce Undersecretary Everett Ehrlich, 46, will leave his post at the end of the month to set up a Washington consulting firm, the New York Times said Wednesday.

The Times said a main client of the firm would be the Major League Baseball Players Association, which he advised before rejoining the government in 1993 to lead the Economics and Statistics Administration.
Ehrlich was quoted as also citing financial reasons for his decision, the paper said.
